title: Bayeh yan manga
intro: Atu ayyunti aydaadu elle yunkuttubeh tan ayyuntak xongoloolak foocal solta. too roocitte seeco tobbeeh, saduh doorteeh, ardi qagitak weeloyse xalootut garaye. Oson miyyaay, keenik baad maca yekkeeh?
clues: Nanu der udduruuk duma sugneeh, farmoyti ni fanak nee fan temeete.
Nanu koona sanama naqbudeeh, ken cabnam cinneh.
Nanu farmoytit tusuuleh, hoxat kaa malkisne.
Nanu usug numma yaabe kaa tekkek digaala bahtam esserne.
Nanu qaraanak rob caxittaah, ardik raceenaani caxittam nuble.
Nanu kudnuh fayyale arooca fan kaqinne, takkay immay mooyat nee raaqeh.

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
verse: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss. (71:21)
